hero.title: Free Website Visibility Strategy Session
hero.lead:
You only have a few seconds to make an impression online.

During this complimentary strategy session, we’ll take a look at your website together and identify opportunities to improve your online visibility, strengthen your messaging, and create a better experience for your audience.

sections:

Your First Impression

Your Messaging

Your Visibility

Book Your Complimentary Strategy Session

title: Winnipeg Website Design
description: Winnipeg website design across three paths: static sites, AI-managed websites, and full WordPress.

hero.title: Winnipeg Website Design Built for Growth & Visibility
hero.lead:
A beautiful website is great. But if nobody finds it, if visitors feel confused, or if people leave without contacting you, it is not doing its job.

Not every business needs the same kind of website. We build static sites for events, landing pages, and funnels; AI-managed websites that we run for you; and full WordPress sites for teams who want to edit and publish themselves.

At Leanne Digital, we bring together Winnipeg website design, SEO, branding, and strategy so your site looks like you, gets found, and actually converts.

sections:
We believe businesses should not have to choose between a beautiful website and one that actually performs.

Too often, we see websites that look amazing but are slow, hard to use, confusing, and never get found online.

Or the opposite

A website that is technically optimized for Google but feels generic, overwhelming, or
disconnected from the business behind it.

We believe you deserve both.

A website that feels like you, builds trust, loads quickly, is easy to navigate, and helps people actually find your business.

— Package 01

Static Website

A static website is the right fit when you need something beautiful, focused, and finished. Think a one-off event site, a sales landing page, or a business funnel that has one job: get people to take action.

These sites are custom HTML, designed with the same care as everything else we build. They can be up to 5 pages. They are not dynamic, and they are not a content management system. If you need to change copy later, we update it for you.

What they are not: an AI Managed website. Static sites do not include the robust AEO and SEO platform that comes with a site we engineer and run for you. They are meant to look excellent, load fast, and do a specific job.

Talk About a Static Site

Best when you need

  • An event, launch, or campaign site with a clear end date or offer
  • A landing page that supports ads or a sales funnel
  • A small business site that does not need a blog or CMS
  • A fast, lightweight build without plugin overhead

— Package 02

AI Managed Websites

An AI Managed website is not a WordPress site with a chatbot in the corner. It is a site we engineer so it can connect to analytics, Search Console, conversion tracking, and authorized AI systems — then we run it for you.

Leanne Digital manages every update and change, usually within hours of your request. You stay focused on the business. We handle the website. Each month you also receive a report covering performance, visibility, and what we recommend next.

Because we control the platform, we can deploy SEO and AEO improvements across the whole site in one change instead of editing pages one by one. Internal linking, structured data, semantic HTML, and accessibility can be treated as a system, not a pile of plugins.

The bigger shift is AI talking to AI. With Model Context Protocol (MCP) and connected data, we can ask the site questions that actually matter: which pages lost traffic, which services generated leads, where internal links are missing. That is a different class of website than a template with a chat bubble.

Talk About an AI Managed Site

What you get

  • A website built as business infrastructure, not just a brochure
  • Google Analytics, Search Console, and conversion data connected
  • SEO and AEO foundations ready for Google and answer engines
  • Site-wide technical updates without editing every page by hand
  • Internal linking and content-structure analysis
  • Custom assistants and MCP-ready connections when you need them
  • Accessibility controls and the ability to adapt as search changes
  • Hands-off management: we handle updates, you receive the monthly report

— Package 03

Full WordPress Website

If your company blogs a lot and likes to edit its own pages, WordPress is still the right tool. You and your team get a full CMS — a place to log in, publish, and run the website yourselves.

We design a custom WordPress site around your brand, then set it up so you can update pages with Elementor. You keep the security and stability of a platform that powers a huge portion of the internet, with training and support after launch so you are not left guessing.

This path is for businesses that want to stay in control of content. If you would rather we handle every change for you, that is the AI Managed path — we manage those sites, and updates are handled within hours of your request.

Talk About a WordPress Site

Best when you want

  • To log in with your team and publish without waiting on a developer
  • A blog and content library you update on your own schedule
  • Elementor so non-technical editors can change pages with confidence
  • A familiar, battle-tested CMS with plugins and ecommerce when needed
  • Ownership of your content, with our design and technical setup behind it

— The problem

Why Most Websites Don't Work

We see it all the time. A business invests in a website, launches it, and then wonders why nobody is contacting them. Usually, it is not because the business is bad. It is because the website is not doing its job.

One of the biggest issues we see with Winnipeg website design is businesses ending up with websites that are either built without strategy or built entirely around trends. Here are some of the biggest problems we notice:

  • 01

Slow Load Times

Nobody likes waiting. If your website feels slow, visitors leave. First impressions happen fast online, and speed matters more than most people realize.

A slow website can affect trust, user experience, conversions, and even SEO performance.

  • 02

Weak or Confusing Messaging

Many websites talk at people instead of to them. When someone lands on your website, they should immediately understand:
  • Who you are
  • What you do
  • Who you help
  • Why it matters
  • What they should do next
If visitors feel confused, overwhelmed, or unsure, they leave.
  • 03

Poor Navigation & User Experience

If people cannot figure out where to go, they are gone. Your website should feel easy to navigate and intuitive to use.

We think carefully about structure, layout, flow, and hierarchy so visitors can quickly find what they are looking for without frustration.

  • 04

The Hero Section Isn't Working Hard Enough

The hero section (that big top section of your website) matters more than most businesses realize. People form an impression of your business within seconds.

If your website does not quickly grab attention, communicate value, and guide someone toward the next step, you are losing opportunities. Clear headlines, thoughtful visuals, strong calls to action, and intentional messaging matter.

  • 05

Generic Templates & Too Much Stock Photography

This one might sound a little
opinionated, but we care deeply about this. Too many businesses end up with websites filled with generic templates and stock photography that feels disconnected from who they actually are.

Your website should feel personal, aligned with your business, and representative of the quality of what you offer. People build trust through connection. And connection comes from showing up clearly and consistently

  • 06

No Clear Calls to Action

A common problem we see is websites that never actually tell visitors what to do next. Someone lands on a website, scrolls for a few seconds, and leaves because there is no clear direction.

Your website should guide people. Whether it is booking a call, requesting a quote, shopping, or learning more, we use thoughtful calls to action to help visitors take the next step naturally and confidently.

Ready for a Website That Actually Works?

— Why Us

Why Winnipeg Businesses Choose Leanne Digital for Web Design

We Combine Branding, SEO, and Web Design

Your customers do not separate your website, branding, and SEO into different categories. They simply experience your business.

That means your website design, visuals, messaging, SEO strategy, and overall brand experience should feel aligned. When businesses show up consistently online, trust grows. And trust leads to more inquiries, stronger brand recognition, and better conversions.

We bring these pieces together intentionally so your website works as a whole, not just as a collection of pages.

We Design for Real Humans (Not Just Search Engines)

SEO matters. A lot. But SEO alone does not grow a business. If someone lands on your website and cannot quickly understand what you do, why they should care, or what they should do next, they leave.

We design websites that speak clearly to your audience, guide visitors naturally, and make taking action feel easy. That means:

  • Clear messaging
  • Strategic calls to action
  • Better usability
  • Thoughtful page structure
  • Conversion-focused layouts
  • SEO-friendly foundations

Because what is the point of a website if nobody sees it? And what is the point of getting traffic if nobody converts?

Why We Use WordPress

If your team wants to log in, edit pages, and publish content yourselves, a full WordPress website is the right fit. It gives you flexibility, ownership, reliability, and room to grow. Prefer we handle every change? See AI Managed websites.

WordPress powers a huge portion of the internet for a reason.

It is reliable, customizable, SEO-friendly, and not going anywhere.

Unlike restrictive website builders that can box businesses in, WordPress gives us the freedom to create a website built around your business rather than forcing your business into a template.

We use WordPress because it allows us to create:

  • Fast-loading websites
  • Fully custom designs
  • Better SEO structure
  • Flexible growth over time
  • Easy-to-update content
  • SEO-friendly foundations
  • Ecommerce integrations
  • Scalable websites built for long-term success

And once your website launches, you are not left figuring things out on your own.

We provide support, training, and guidance so you feel confident managing your website moving forward.

— What We Offer

Website Design & Support Services in Winnipeg

Your website is not a one-time thing. It is a living part of your business. That is why we offer services that support your website at every stage of growth.

Custom Website Design

Need something fully custom? We design strategic websites around your goals, audience, messaging, and brand — whether that is an AI Managed site we run for you, or a full WordPress build your team can edit.

Whether you are redesigning an outdated website or launching something brand new, we create websites that feel professional, easy to navigate, and built to convert.

Landing Pages

Launching a service? Running ads? Promoting an offer? A static website or focused landing page is designed with one goal in mind: helping people take action.

We build strategic landing pages focused on messaging, calls to action, and conversions.

One Page Websites

Need to get online quickly? Our one-page and small static websites are perfect for events, funnels, and businesses that need a professional presence without a CMS.

They are designed strategically and can grow into an AI Managed or WordPress site later if you need more.

WordPress Maintenance & Security

Websites need maintenance. We
help keep WordPress websites healthy through updates, backups, monitoring, troubleshooting, and security support.

Because broken websites are stressful. And they cost businesses opportunities.

Website Hosting

Email Setup & Configuration

Need help with professional
business email, Google Workspace, DNS, or email setup? We help configure the technical side of things so everything works properly and feels less overwhelming.

Ongoing SEO Support

SEO is not a one-time checkbox. We offer ongoing SEO support to help businesses improve visibility, strengthen rankings, and bring more qualified traffic to their websites through:
  • Keyword strategy
  • On-page SEO improvements
  • Blog optimization
  • Local SEO
  • Technical SEO monitoring
  • Internal linking strategies
  • AI search visibility optimization

Website Support & Troubleshooting

Sometimes websites break. Plugins conflict. Forms stop working. Things slow down.

We help businesses troubleshoot website problems and get things running smoothly again without the stress.

Ecommerce Integration

Want to sell online? We help businesses integrate ecommerce solutions into WordPress websites so selling products, services, or bookings feels seamless and easy to manage.

Let’s Find the Right Fit

Our Website Design Process

Building a website should feel exciting, not overwhelming. One of the things clients often tell us after working together is how supported and stress-free the process felt.

We believe great websites happen when there is collaboration, strategy, and a clear plan. That is why we follow a thoughtful, step-by-step process designed to keep things organized, transparent, and focused on results.

1

Discovery & Strategy

Every project starts with a conversation. We take time to understand your business,
goals, audience, challenges, and what success actually looks like for your website.

Who are you trying to reach? What do you want visitors to do? What is currently
working and what is not?

We also look at competitors, messaging opportunities, SEO foundations, and website
goals so strategy is guiding decisions from the start.

2

Design Comes First

This is one of the biggest things that makes our process different. We do not jump
straight into development. Before we build anything, we design it first.

Think of it like building a house. You would not start construction without blueprints.
Your website design acts as the blueprint. This stage helps us plan:

  • Messaging and hierarchy
  • Calls to action
  • User experience and navigation
  • Branding consistency
  • Content structure
  • Layout and usability
By designing first, we can make sure your website actually works for your audience before development even begins. It also makes revisions easier and helps avoid expensive surprises later.
3

Development & Technical Setup

Once the design is approved, we move into development. This is where strategy becomes reality.

Your website is built with responsiveness, performance, usability, SEO foundations, and clean structure in mind. We carefully test layouts, functionality, responsiveness, forms, and user experience so everything feels polished and works properly.

4

Launch, Support & Growth

Launching your website is not the end. It is the beginning.

We are here to support you after launch with training, website support, SEO,
troubleshooting, hosting, updates, and growth-focused improvements. Because a
website should evolve alongside your business.

— Our Team

The Best of Both Worlds: Strategy + Technical Expertise

One of the things that makes Leanne Digital different is that you are not just getting a designer.

You are getting the best of both worlds.

With over 10 years of experience in graphic design, website design, UX, and digital marketing, I bring a strategic and creative perspective to every website we build.

I have worked both in-house and at a digital marketing agency, which means I have seen what works, what does not, and how businesses actually use websites to grow.

I graduated from both the Graphic Design and Digital Multimedia Design programs at Red River College, and over the years I have developed a strong understanding of messaging, branding, user experience, digital marketing, and conversion-focused design.

I care deeply about making sure websites feel clear, trustworthy, beautiful, and aligned with the businesses behind them.

But behind every great website is strong technical execution too.

That is where our CTO and developer partner, Gary Burns, comes in.

Gary brings deep technical expertise in WordPress development, website performance, hosting, DNS, email configuration, security, troubleshooting, technical SEO, server setup, migrations, and all the behind-the-scenes systems that make websites run smoothly.

CEO | Strategy & design — Leanne Jones

The creative side

I focus on strategy, messaging, branding, user experience, design, and making sure your website speaks clearly to your audience.

CTO & development — Gary Burns

The technical side
Gary makes sure it is technically solid, fast, secure, scalable, and built properly from the ground up, with careful attention to performance, security, hosting, integrations, and long-term stability.

This combination matters.

Because one of the biggest problems we see in web design is businesses being forced to choose between two extremes.

A designer builds a beautiful website that nobody ever finds online.

Or a developer builds something technically functional that works behind the scenes but feels cold, generic, or disconnected from the business.

We believe you should not have to choose.

You deserve a website that looks professional, loads quickly, feels aligned with your brand, is easy to navigate, and has the technical structure to help people actually find it online.

That is the difference thoughtful strategy and technical expertise make when they work together.

Work With a Team That Gets Design and SEO

— Who We Are

Proudly Indigenous-Owned & Operated

  • Indigenous Owned
  • Treaty 1 Territory

Leanne Digital is a proudly Indigenous-owned business based in Winnipeg, Manitoba.

As a member of Peguis First Nation and certified Indigenous business owner, supporting Indigenous businesses, organizations, and communities is deeply personal to me. I understand the importance of storytelling, authenticity, trust, and building meaningful relationships because this is lived experience, not something I approach from the outside.

We have had the privilege of supporting Indigenous entrepreneurs, businesses, organizations, and communities while helping bring ideas, services, and stories online in ways that feel thoughtful, professional, and aligned with who they are.

Whether we are working with Indigenous organizations, local businesses, or growing brands, our goal is always the same: to create websites that feel trustworthy, meaningful, and genuinely reflective of the people behind them.

— Good To Know

Frequently Asked Questions for Winnipeg Website Design

How much does a website cost?

This is the question everyone wants to know.

And honestly, website pricing can feel a little confusing. It is a bit of the wild west out there. You might get one quote for a few hundred dollars and another for several thousand, leaving you wondering what the actual difference is.

The reality is that website pricing depends on goals, functionality, number of pages, ecommerce needs, SEO, integrations, and the strategy involved.

The right number depends on which path you choose — a static site, an AI-managed website, or a full WordPress build — plus page count, functionality, and the strategy involved.

We’ll look at your goals together, recommend the right package, and give you a clear quote before any work begins.

Why do you use WordPress?

WordPress is one of three paths we offer. We still love it when a business wants to log in, edit pages with Elementor, publish blogs, and stay in control of content.

It powers a huge portion of the internet for good reason: it is reliable, scalable, and familiar for teams who want a full CMS.

If you would rather we handle every update for you, an AI Managed website is the better fit.

Will my website be SEO-friendly?

It depends on the package.

AI Managed websites are built for SEO and Answer Engine Optimization from day one, with structured data, semantic HTML, internal linking, and the ability to roll out site-wide improvements as search changes.

WordPress sites still get strong technical foundations, heading structure, usability, speed, and search-friendly best practices.

Static websites are well designed and built cleanly, but they do not include the robust AEO/SEO platform that comes with an AI Managed site.

Can I update my website myself?

On a WordPress website, yes. After launch we provide training so you and your team can update pages with Elementor, swap images, change text, and publish blogs.

AI Managed websites are managed by Leanne Digital. Every update and change is handled by us, usually within hours of your request, and you receive a monthly report.

Static websites are not a CMS. They are a finished set of pages. If you need changes later, we update them for you.

How long does it take to build a website?

It depends on the size and complexity of the project.

Smaller websites and landing pages typically move faster, while larger custom WordPress websites may take more time depending on content, revisions, and functionality. For a standard website project, timelines are usually around 1 to 2 months from strategy and design through development and launch.

We will always communicate timelines clearly so you know what to expect and feel supported throughout the process.

Do you only work with Winnipeg businesses?

Not at all. While we specialize in Winnipeg website design, we work with businesses, organizations, and entrepreneurs across Manitoba, Canada and The United States.

Hey Winnipeg, Let's Build a Website That Actually Works

Whether you are redesigning an outdated website, launching a new business, improving visibility online, or finally ready for a website that feels aligned with the quality of your business, we would love to help.

At Leanne Digital, we combine Winnipeg website design, AI-managed platforms, WordPress expertise, SEO strategy, branding, and thoughtful user experience to create websites that look good, work hard, and grow with your business.

Tell us about what you are building and let’s create something meaningful together.

Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions about keeping your WordPress site secure? We’ve got you covered! Here are some of the most common inquiries about WordPress security and SEO and how we help to protect your site. Whether you’re new to website security or need expert advice, we’re here to ensure your site stays safe, updated, and performing at its best.

Why is WordPress Security so important

WordPress is the most widely used website platform, making it a prime target for hackers. Ensuring your site’s security protects your data, prevents downtime, and helps maintain customer trust.

How do I know if my WordPress site is secure?

Regular security scans, updated plugins, and strong password practices are key indicators. We offer thorough security audits to assess your site’s vulnerabilities and provide ongoing monitoring.

What should I do if my site is hacked?
If your WordPress site is hacked, immediate action is required to minimize damage. We provide hack recovery services, restoring your site from recent backups and securing any weaknesses to prevent future attacks. We take daily backups of your site, and also go back 30 days in case you need something from a previous date.
How often should I update my WordPress plugins and themes?
WordPress plugins and themes should be updated regularly to patch vulnerabilities and improve functionality. We manage updates for you, ensuring your site always runs on the latest and safest versions.
What can I do to prevent malware on my WordPress site?

Implementing strong security measures like malware scanning, firewall protection, and routine backups can significantly reduce the risk of malware infections. We monitor your site 24/7 to catch any potential threats early and keep it clean.

If I choose a package with 1 or 2 hours worth of website work, what does that mean?
When you purchase a package with 1 or 2 hours of website design work, you gain the freedom to use it however you like. Whether it’s updating existing copy, redesigning sections, adding new features, optimizing layout, or even refreshing visuals—this time is yours to customize your website to fit your evolving needs.
Can you really monitor my competitors keywords, and help me use them on my own site?
Absolutely! We use advanced software to track how your competitors are ranking and identify the keywords driving their success. By analyzing this valuable data, we can help you optimize your website with the same high-performing keywords, giving you a competitive edge. With this insight, we’ll tailor your content and SEO strategy to improve your rankings, attract more traffic, and position your site to outperform the competition.

What is Answer Engine Optimization?
AEO is the process of structuring your website so it can be used as a source in AI-generated answers on platforms like ChatGPT and Google.
How is AEO different from SEO?
SEO focuses on ranking in search results. AEO focuses on being included in the answer itself. The two work together.

Our approach to paid advertising

We’ve found that most businesses have tried paid advertising at one time or another — but most walk away disappointed with the results. They boost a few ads, set up a quick campaign, and expect leads to start pouring in. When that doesn’t happen, they assume Google Ads “doesn’t work” for their industry.

The truth is, building a profitable campaign on your own — without a deep understanding of SEO, user intent, and data strategy — is extremely difficult. Every Google Ads campaign is essentially a highly focused, accelerated SEO campaign. You’re competing in real time for visibility, attention, and clicks.

To succeed, you need to understand your target audience at a granular level. You need strategic keyword research that goes beyond surface-level terms. You need compelling ad copy that speaks directly to intent. And you need to deliver that message to the right demographic, in the right location, at the exact moment they’re searching.

That’s where we come in.

We don’t just “run ads.” We build structured, data-driven campaigns designed to attract qualified traffic, convert visitors into leads, and turn ad spend into measurable business growth.
